extra.ground_truth: Marie Curie became the first female Nobel laureate in 1903, in Physics. The prize was split: one half to Henri Becquerel for discovering spontaneous radioactivity, the other half jointly to Marie and Pierre Curie for their radiation research.

1. Nobel Prize awarded women — NobelPrize.org — https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/lists/nobel-prize-awarded-women/
   Marie Curie was the first woman to be awarded a Nobel Prize, in Physics in 1903, and remains the only woman honoured twice.

2. Marie Curie — Facts — https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1903/marie-curie/facts/
   The Nobel Prize in Physics 1903 was divided, one half to Henri Becquerel, the other half jointly to Pierre and Marie Curie.

3. Marie Curie — Wikipedia — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marie_Curie
   In 1911 she won a second Nobel, in Chemistry, for the discovery of radium and polonium.
1903 Physics, shared with Henri Becquerel — verifying the split on the official Nobel page.
